title: Soft Rise
description: Khối chữ trồi lên 24 px, hết nhoè 8 px và rõ dần cùng lúc trong 0.9 giây.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio soft-rise, written here): Text block: y +24 → 0 px, blur 8 → 0 px and opacity 0 → 1 together in 900 ms sine.out (site bezier .61,1,.88,1). Site exit: fade 350 ms sine.in, no move. Site tips: 16–28 px of travel, 4–10 px of blur; the blur may clear just before the move ends. Params: duration (0.9 s) · y: quãng trồi (24 px) · blur (8 px) · ease (sine.out).
